consequence.statement: Purely additive optional configuration: the release note only describes a new ability to specify the Vault server's certificate server-name and states no change to existing behavior, so environments that do not set the new option are unaffected.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds configuration to the Vault issuer allowing the server-name to be specified when validating the certificates the Vault server presents; the release note does not name the exact CRD field.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The release note names the new option only in prose ('the server-name ... the Vault issuer'); it does not state the CRD group, kind, or the schema field path, and no artifact context is provided to settle the exact field name and path.; applicability: Exposure would be 'the environment configures a Vault issuer', but the evidence does not name the API group/kind or the Vault configuration field path, so the condition cannot be spelled from the evidence alone.
